title: Itrat e athaar
body:
itrat-e-athaar ke ghamkhwar ashaab-e-hussain
lashkar-e-abbas ke jarrar ashaab-e-hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
jab charag-e-qaimae-shah-e-shaheeda gul hua
kya habeeb ibne mazahir kya zaheer-o-ausaja
joshe nusrat mein har ek chehra munawar hogaya
karbala mein hai falak asaar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
raat bhar mehve talaya hai haram ke pasban
har qadam par nara-e-takbir hai wird-e-zaban
mashvare baham ye hai ke kiski jaaye pehle jaan
hai shab-e-ashoor se tayyar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
koshishe ye hai ke hamla ho to aage hum bade
taygh ke johar dikhaye sab se pehle hum lade
lashkar-e-aada ki nazre bhi na qaimo par pade
azm mein hai aahani devaar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
hur azaan-e-subh par aaye haraval hogaye
khoon ki surkhi se apni sab khatayein dho gaye
mil gaya rumaal-e-zehra neend aayi sogaye
dasht-e-ghurbat mein bhi hai meyar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
rok lenge apne seeno par har ek zarb e laayein
aap padhiyega namaz ay sarwar-e-dunya o deen
ham namaz-e-zuhr pad lenge sar e khuld e bareen
keh rahe hai ye basad asrar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
waqt-e-nazha john ka sar apne zano par rakha
martaba ek ye bhi aaqa ne ghulamon ko diya
aa gayi khushbu lahoo mein jism raushan hogaya
maut se hai kis qadar sarshaar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaima-e-shabbir mein ab be zaban koi nahi
qabre asghar dhoop mein hai sayeban koi nahi
shaah-e-deen maqtal mein hai aur meherban koi nahi
kaash jee ut'the faqat ek baar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
<<DIVIDER>>
ruk na jaaye shiddate gham se kahin nabz-e-imam
be-rida hai bibiyna shahid sare bazaar-e-shaam
peysh honge sab haram ab bar sar-e-darbar-e-aam
aur udhar maqtal mein hai lachaar ashaab-e-hussain
itrat-e-athaar ke…
author: Shahid Jafer
